name: markdown-live-render-tables
description: A VS Code extension for editing markdown in a live rendered editor.

markdownLiveRenderTables.lineHighlight.e.description: Highlight the active line outside rendered tables in the Markdown Live Editor. Table highlighting and editing are unchanged.

markdownLiveRenderTables.debug.description: Write live editor cursor, focus, and source edit diagnostics to the Markdown Live Editor output channel.

markdownLiveRenderTables.tableNavigation.markdownDescription: Key or combination to hold while pressing an arrow key to move to an adjacent rendered table cell. Examples: `F2`, `Control`, `Alt+Shift`, `Ctrl+Space`, `KeyQ`, `Numpad0`. Accepts keyboard key/code names; the chosen key is reserved while editing cells.

markdownLiveRenderTables.clipboard.defau.description: Default representation used by Copy in the Markdown Live Editor. Smart keeps lists inside spreadsheet cells; Rich preserves semantic lists for word processors.
Default interpretation used by Paste in the Markdown Live Editor. Automatic prefers lossless internal data, then HTML, Markdown, and plain text.

markdownLiveRenderTables.markdownRenderi.description: Use Obsidian-style Live Preview: hide inactive Markdown syntax, reveal it at the caret, render properties/callouts/code, and enable task, list, and link controls. Disable to restore ordinary non-table source editing; rendered tables remain available.
Always show heading # markers in the Markdown Live Editor. Disable to hide them in inactive headings and reveal them while editing. Heading colors and text size are preserved.

markdownLiveRenderTables.tableShortcuts..markdownDescription: Shortcut to insert a row below while editing a table cell. Use modifiers plus a keyboard key/code (for example `Ctrl+Enter` or `Alt+KeyR`). Set to an empty string to disable.
Shortcut to insert a row above while editing a table cell. Use modifiers plus a keyboard key/code (for example `Ctrl+Enter` or `Alt+KeyR`). Set to an empty string to disable.
Shortcut to insert a column right while editing a table cell. Use modifiers plus a keyboard key/code (for example `Ctrl+Enter` or `Alt+KeyR`). Set to an empty string to disable.
Shortcut to insert a column left while editing a table cell. Use modifiers plus a keyboard key/code (for example `Ctrl+Enter` or `Alt+KeyR`). Set to an empty string to disable.
